_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: audience=api.atlassian.com is required on the authorize URL. Without it the token comes back scoped to nothing useful.
offline_access is what produces a refresh token.
Read-only scopes only. Nothing in the catalogue writes to Jira or Confluence, and write scopes on a ticketing system are the kind an agent should not hold by default.
Every API call needs the cloudid, fetched once from https://api.atlassian.com/oauth/token/accessible-resources - the site URL is not usable as an API host.

accessible_resources.notes: Call this first; it returns the cloudid every other call needs.

rate_limits.note: Cost-based per app per tenant, returned as 429 with Retry-After. Jira search with many fields is expensive; request only the fields needed.
